utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, I was just talking to Jules about the repair drive this weekend. I'm not sure of the exact time yet, but I can ask around. Want me to find out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, if you could find out the exact time, that'd be great. I want to make sure I'm there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Alright, I'll ask around and get back to you with the time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'm bringing a bunch of wrenches and screwdrivers, plus some old lawnmower parts. Not sure what everyone else is bringing, though.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like you're well-prepared. I might see if I can bring that broken lamp from my porch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, a lamp! Bring it along—I've got some spare wiring and sockets that might do the trick.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, do you know if we have enough paint and brushes for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hmm, I'm not sure about the paint and brushes. I've been focused on the list of repairs. Maybe check with Faye?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good idea, I'll ask Faye about the supplies. Thanks, Eli!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Faye, I'm sorry, I keep losing track—did you say the drive is 9 to noon? And where exactly?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 9 to noon. We're setting up at the community center parking lot. I'll be there to receive donations.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, community center parking lot. Got it. I'll try to swing by if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: But Pia said it's for playground equipment... Mina, are you sure about small appliances?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's actually for the community center roof, not playground equipment or appliances.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the roof? So maybe my toaster isn't relevant after all. Can you tell me what kind of repairs they need for the roof?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, are you coming to the repair drive this weekend? We could use all the help we can get.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'll be there—might be a bit late, but I'll definitely show up to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll make sure to save you a spot. Bring a friend if you want—we're making it a whole community thing!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I heard the repair drive's picking up. Any word on how many people are joining?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not sure on the count, but they're fixing small appliances, so bring anything that needs a repair.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I might have a toaster that's been acting up. Do they take those?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Opal, I'm glad you're interested, but I'm really worried about safety—we need to make sure everyone knows what they're doing with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Don't worry, Pia, we're planning a quick safety briefing before we start handing out any tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, a safety briefing—that's a start. But can we also have a sign-up list so we know who's comfortable with which tasks?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about this repair drive? I've heard some shady things about those.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven't heard that. I just know Mina mentioned she's bringing her toaster.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A toaster? That's it? I'm still not convinced this drive is legit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard. Just keep it quick, you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, Cleo's worried we might be short on paint and brushes. You know anyone who can spare some?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo! Have you heard about the repair drive this weekend at the community center? Starts at 10 AM Saturday—spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. Need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Leo! Bring any basic tools you have—hammers, screwdrivers, that kind of stuff. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara! I just got word that the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, thanks for letting me know! I guess we should still meet tomorrow to update our flyers and plan for Sunday then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, that sounds perfect! Let's adjust the flyers and get ready for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'll be at the community center from 9 to noon to accept donations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks Faye! I wasn't sure about the details. I'll try to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll keep an eye out for you!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia, just wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday? But the community center already has a yoga class then—are we sure we'll have enough room?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I didn't know about the yoga class! Let me check with the center about sharing the space—maybe we can use the multipurpose room.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about this repair drive? I've heard some shady things about those.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Really? I've only heard good things—everyone's been pulling together to help out neighbors in need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I've seen it sit untouched for weeks, though. Are you sure it's actually helping anyone?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's coming along slowly, but we're hopeful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's good to hear! I mentioned it to Jules, and we're thinking of getting the gardening club to bring tools. Any idea what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it starts around 10 in the morning, but I'm not entirely sure.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, need a hand with the repair drive? I'm free this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That'd be great, Sam! I could use an extra pair of hands this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I'll be at the community center at 10. Let's get that roof fixed!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Leo, do we have enough paint and brushes for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll check the inventory. Let me know if we need more.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Leo. Let me know what you find—I want to make sure we're stocked before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think we have a few, but let me double-check the supply closet. I'll have a count for you soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Don't forget the repair drive this weekend; they're fixing small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, it's this Saturday at the community center. I've already marked it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Rey, the repair drive... remind me again, is it for fixing the community center or collecting electronics?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's about fixing the old playground equipment, not electronics. Pia mentioned something about liability.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Playground equipment? Huh, I could've sworn Sam said something about a roof. Well, I'll just go with whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's going to be a great day. You got anything needs fixing, Jules?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Maybe just that squeaky hinge on my garden gate, but I'm more excited to see everyone pitch in. Have you talked to Pia lately? She's a bit nervous about the whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ah, Pia'll be fine. I'll bring some extra WD-40 for that gate, no problem.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sorry, Mara, I'm a bit lost—was the drop-off from 9 to noon or later?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's from 9 to noon, Noah. Faye and I were just finalizing that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, right, 9 to noon. Got it. Thanks for clearing that up, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not certain yet, but Vik said he'd ask around and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, I've been telling everyone about the drive—hope you can make it! Let me know if you need directions.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. I'm still waiting to hear back from Vik before I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, so it's for the playground equipment? What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, just some rusty swings and a wobbly slide. Nothing too major.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, just swings and slide. So definitely not toaster territory, huh?
